sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%隐形》。

sentences.en: I'm Katie Mingle, filling in for Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是凯蒂·明格尔，代班罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: In the early morning of September 20th, 2017, a Category 4 hurricane hit the island of Puerto Rico.
sentences.zh: 2017年9月20日清晨，一场四级飓风袭击了波多黎各岛。

sentences.en: Hurricane Maria slamming into the island, and as you heard, one official saying the island
sentences.zh: 飓风“玛丽亚”猛烈撞击该岛，正如你所听到的，一位官员称该岛

sentences.en: is destroyed.
sentences.zh: 已被摧毁。

sentences.en: The first Category 4 storm to strike Puerto Rico in 85 years.
sentences.zh: 这是85年来袭击波多黎各的首场四级风暴。

sentences.en: Power lines are down.
sentences.zh: 输电线断了。

sentences.en: Streets are impassable.
sentences.zh: 街道无法通行。

sentences.en: Many roads are flooded.
sentences.zh: 许多道路被淹。

sentences.en: Maria was a beast of a hurricane, the strongest one to hit the island since 1932.
sentences.zh: “玛丽亚”是一场凶猛的飓风，是自1932年以来袭击该岛最强的一场。

sentences.en: The wind was blowing 155 miles an hour, which is very close to being a Category 5.
sentences.zh: 风速达到每小时155英里，非常接近五级飓风的水平。

sentences.en: And it didn't just hit one stretch of the coaSt. It actually moved across the whole island,
sentences.zh: 它不仅仅袭击了海岸的一段，而是横扫了整个岛屿，

sentences.en: ripping up everything in its path.
sentences.zh: 摧毁了沿途的一切。

sentences.en: You know, brush everywhere, trees down, power lines down, obviously everywhere.
sentences.zh: 到处都是灌木丛，树木倒塌，电线断裂，显然到处都是。

sentences.en: You know, the entire island in the dark.
sentences.zh: 整个岛屿陷入了一片黑暗。

sentences.en: That's Daniel Alarcón.
sentences.zh: 那是丹尼尔·阿拉尔孔。

sentences.en: He spent some time reporting in Puerto Rico after the storm and
sentences.zh: 他在风暴过后在波多黎各进行了一段时间的报道，

sentences.en: wrote an article about it for Wired magazine.
sentences.zh: 并为《连线》杂志写了一篇相关文章。

sentences.en: The next morning, people wake up.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，人们醒来。

sentences.en: They go out of their houses, their apartments.
sentences.zh: 他们走出自己的房子、公寓。

sentences.zh: 他们看向街道，查看损失，并开始试图理解他们

sentences.zh: 眼前所看到的一切。

sentences.zh: 那段视频是豪尔赫在风暴过后的第二天拍摄的。

sentences.en: He's from the capital city of San Juan,
sentences.zh: 他来自首府圣胡安，

sentences.en: and he told me he was just totally caught off guard by how bad this storm was.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，这场风暴的严重程度让他完全措手不及。

sentences.en: It really became obviously known for everybody around that we were in deep trouble.
sentences.zh: 每个人都清楚地意识到，我们陷入了巨大的麻烦。

sentences.en: But it wasn't for a few days when Jorge actually made it into work that he fully grasped the scale
sentences.zh: 但直到几天后，豪尔赫真正去上班时，他才完全领会了这场危机的

sentences.en: of the crisis.
sentences.zh: 规模。

sentences.en: He works at PREPA, which stands for Puerto Rican Electric Power Authority.
sentences.zh: 他在PREPA工作，即波多黎各电力局。

sentences.en: It's the

sentences.zh: 我到达了发电厂。

sentences.zh: 因为大多数人都住在内陆。

sentences.zh: 当他到达那里时，他走向那个显示着

sentences.en: the outline of Puerto Rico.
sentences.zh: 波多黎各轮廓的大电脑屏幕。

sentences.en: And inside of that, a bunch of lines, kind of like a big connect the dots
sentences.zh: 在轮廓里面，有一堆线条，就像一个巨大的连点游戏，

sentences.en: with each line representing a power line.
sentences.zh: 每一条线代表一条输电线。

sentences.en: And every blinking line, it means a down power line.
sentences.zh: 每一条闪烁的线，都意味着一条输电线断了。

sentences.en: And the whole island was blinking.
sentences.zh: 整个岛屿都在闪烁。

sentences.en: Every single line was down.
sentences.zh: 每一条线都断了。

sentences.en: Every single line in the island was down.
sentences.zh: 岛上每一条线都断了。

sentences.en: And that had never happened before.
sentences.zh: 这种情况以前从未发生过。

sentences.en: The trajectory of Maria was almost as if it had been designed by an evil genius.
sentences.zh: “玛丽亚”的轨迹简直就像是由一个邪恶的天才设计出来的。

sentences.en: The way it cut across the island was such that it essentially struck every major transmission line.
sentences.zh: 它横穿岛屿的方式，基本上击中了每一条主要的输电线。

sentences.en: The scale of the destruction to the power grid was hard even for Jorge Bracero to comprehend.
sentences.zh: 电网遭到破坏的规模，即使对豪尔赫·布拉塞罗来说也难以理解。

sentences.en: And he knew that day that he would spend the next several months helping Puerto Rico recover through his work with PREPA.
sentences.zh: 那天他知道，接下来的几个月里，他将通过在PREPA的工作帮助波多黎各恢复。

sentences.en: What he didn't know yet was that thousands of people would come to count on him, specifically him,
sentences.zh: 他当时还不知道，成千上万的人会指望他，专门指望他，

sentences.en: to help them get through their year in the dark.
sentences.zh: 来帮助他们度过黑暗的一年。

sentences.en: Jorge Bracero is one of those people who you can tell you're going to like just by seeing a picture of him.
sentences.zh: 豪尔赫·布拉塞罗就是那种你一看照片就会觉得你会喜欢的人。

sentences.en: He's in his late 30s with short brown hair and a beard.
sentences.zh: 他三十多岁，留着棕色短发和胡须。

sentences.en: And he just looks like a nice guy.
sentences.zh: 他看起来就是一个好人。

sentences.en: I think it's something about his eyes.
sentences.zh: 我想这和他的眼睛有关。

sentences.en: Daniel Alarcón describes him as delightfully nerdy.
sentences.zh: 丹尼尔·阿拉尔孔形容他“可爱地书呆子气”。

sentences.en: He's a guy who will sit and explain to you how an electrical grid works, you know, like and continue to explain it in minute detail,
sentences.zh: 他是一个会坐下来向你解释电网是如何工作的人，你知道，就像会继续详细地解释，

sentences.en: even after it's clear that you like can no longer understand what he's talking about.
sentences.zh: 即使很明显你已经听不懂他在说什么了。

sentences.en: Jorge has worked for PREPA for 13 years and his job there is a grueling one.
sentences.zh: 豪尔赫在PREPA工作了13年，他的工作非常艰苦。

sentences.en: He's responsible for operating two 15 story tall boilers.
sentences.zh: 他负责操作两台15层楼高的锅炉。

sentences.en: These boilers are heated by 20 giant burners that Jorge also looks after.
sentences.zh: 这些锅炉由20个巨大的燃烧器加热，豪尔赫也负责照看这些燃烧器。

sentences.en: And so he's constantly hiking up and down these stairs that service the different parts of this massively tall equipment.
sentences.zh: 所以他必须不断地爬上爬下这些楼梯，为这些极其高大的设备的各个部分提供服务。

sentences.en: It's extremely hot.
sentences.zh: 那里非常热。

sentences.en: You know, every day you're just smelling of petrol and diesel and it's extremely exhausting.
sentences.zh: 你知道，每天你身上都闻着汽油和柴油的味道，而且非常累人。

sentences.en: Sometimes you just hate it.
sentences.zh: 有时候你简直讨厌它。

sentences.en: When Maria hit, Jorge and his wife Charlotte rode out the storm at her family's house.
sentences.zh: 当“玛丽亚”来袭时，豪尔赫和他的妻子夏洛特在她家人的房子里躲避风暴。

sentences.en: They weren't hurt, but they were surrounded by devastation.
sentences.zh: 他们没有受伤，但被满目疮痍所包围。

sentences.en: And they found out some really sad news.
sentences.zh: 而且他们得知了一些非常悲伤的消息。

sentences.en: Charlotte's best friend, who was pregnant, had gone into stress-induced early labor the day the storm hit and lost the baby.
sentences.zh: 夏洛特最好的朋友怀孕了，在风暴来袭的那天因压力过大而早产，失去了孩子。

sentences.en: This was particularly frightening to them because Charlotte was also pregnant.
sentences.zh: 这对他们来说特别可怕，因为夏洛特也怀孕了。

sentences.en: It was the most tense I've ever been in my life.
sentences.zh: 那是我一生中最紧张的时刻。

sentences.en: What if Charlotte also went into early labor?
sentences.zh: 如果夏洛特也早产了怎么办？

sentences.en: Or what if the baby was born but couldn't survive the post-Maria world with no electricity and temperatures routinely in the 90s?
sentences.zh: 或者如果孩子出生了，却无法在“玛丽亚”过后的世界里生存，没有电，气温经常在90多华氏度（约32摄氏度以上）？

sentences.en: Because when you sleep at night, that heat was so unbearable.
sentences.zh: 因为当你晚上睡觉时，那种热度是如此难以忍受。

sentences.en: I'm serious.
sentences.zh: 我是认真的。

sentences.en: The amount of heat in the air was so, so brutal that you would think, you know, I'm just going to get naked outside because I can't contain this damn heat.
sentences.zh: 空气中的热量是如此残酷，以至于你会想，你知道，我干脆在外面赤身裸体算了，因为我无法忍受这该死的热气。

sentences.en: So I'm thinking a newborn can't survive this.
sentences.zh: 所以我心想，新生儿无法在这种环境下生存。

sentences.en: Jorge even considered trying to get his wife off the island.
sentences.zh: 豪尔赫甚至考虑过设法让他的妻子离开该岛。

sentences.en: But eight months pregnant, they don't allow you to fly.
sentences.zh: 但怀孕八个月了，他们不允许你乘飞机。

sentences.en: After the storm, Jorge and Charlotte bounced from place to place, staying with friends who had generators.
sentences.zh: 风暴过后，豪尔赫和夏洛特从一个地方搬到另一个地方，和有发电机的亲友住在一起。

sentences.en: At home, Jorge fretted over his wife and the baby who was coming, ready or not, in November.
sentences.zh: 在家里，豪尔赫为他的妻子和即将于11月出生（无论准备好与否）的孩子感到担忧。

sentences.en: At work, things were even more stressful.
sentences.zh: 在工作中，情况更加紧张。

sentences.en: The first priority was to get power to hospitals and water treatment plants.
sentences.zh: 首要任务是为医院和水处理厂供电。

sentences.en: Jorge's power plant was one of seven major plants on the island, but all of the others were down.
sentences.zh: 豪尔赫的发电厂是岛上七大发电厂之一，但其他所有发电厂都瘫痪了。

sentences.en: And without those to help, his kept crashing.
sentences.zh: 由于没有其他发电厂的帮助，他的电厂不断崩溃。

sentences.en: Over and over again, because, you know, it would connect as many hospitals as we can, but it just wouldn't hold it.
sentences.zh: 一次又一次，因为，你知道，它会连接尽可能多的医院，但就是支撑不住。

sentences.en: Jorge described this like a tug of war.
sentences.zh: 豪尔赫形容这就像一场拔河比赛。

sentences.en: The power plants are on one side and they're giants, but the consumers are on the other side and they pull hard.
sentences.zh: 发电厂在一边，它们是巨人，但消费者在另一边，他们用力拉扯。

sentences.en: If one power plant goes down, the others will have to work harder and they get tired, sometimes to the point of collapse.
sentences.zh: 如果一个发电厂倒下，其他的就必须更努力地工作，它们会感到疲惫，有时甚至会崩溃。

sentences.en: After Maria, there was only one giant power plant on Jorge's side of the rope.
sentences.zh: “玛丽亚”过后，豪尔赫这边的绳子上只有一个巨大的发电厂。

sentences.en: And on the other side, hospitals and water treatment plants, which were pulling like crazy.
sentences.zh: 而在另一边，医院和水处理厂在疯狂地拉扯。

sentences.en: Every time there's a collapse, you have to reboot everything again.
sentences.zh: 每次崩溃，你都必须重新启动一切。

sentences.en: Eight hours of work just went down the drain and you have to restart from step one.
sentences.zh: 八小时的工作付诸东流，你必须从第一步重新开始。

sentences.en: With just one plant that was constantly collapsing, they had to triage.
sentences.zh: 由于只有一个不断崩溃的发电厂，他们必须进行分诊。

sentences.en: It was like, I only have one power plant that just got fired up.
sentences.zh: 就像是，我只有一个刚启动的发电厂。

sentences.en: And I only have enough power for one of those two hospitals right there.
sentences.zh: 而我只有足够的电力供应那两家医院中的一家。

sentences.en: Out in the field, things weren't any better.
sentences.zh: 在现场，情况也好不到哪去。

sentences.en: Lines were down all over the island and there weren't nearly enough workers to fix them.
sentences.zh: 岛上到处都是断裂的电线，没有足够的工人来修理它们。

sentences.en: And this sense of being forgotten, you know?
sentences.zh: 那种被遗忘的感觉，你懂吗？

sentences.en: Jorge continued with his daily updates, which lines were being fixed, where the brigades were
sentences.zh: 豪尔赫继续发布每日更新，告知哪些线路正在维修，电力部门的抢修队和美国承包商接下来

sentences.en: headed next to the team AEE brigades and the American contractors.
sentences.zh: 要去哪里。

sentences.en: And to keep up a sense of momentum, he also shared videos as new places got power.
sentences.zh: 为了保持一种推进感，他还分享了新地区通电时的视频。

sentences.en: Like this one, where an elementary school in the town of Puerto Nuevo finally gets electricity.
sentences.zh: 就像这一段，新港镇的一所小学终于通电了。

sentences.en: This video was taken on someone's iPhone from the hallway of the school.
sentences.zh: 这段视频是有人用 iPhone 在学校走廊里拍的。

sentences.en: Kids are running by with their arms in the air going completely bananas.
sentences.zh: 孩子们高举双臂跑过，兴奋得简直要疯了。

sentences.en: The teachers are jumping up and down.
sentences.zh: 老师们也在又蹦又跳。

sentences.en: It's just pure joy.
sentences.zh: 那真是纯粹的喜悦。

sentences.en: It made me so happy to see it that I figured people would be happy to see it, too.
sentences.zh: 看到这一幕让我感到非常高兴，我想大家看到也会很高兴的。

sentences.en: Every week, it seemed a new town was celebrating.
sentences.zh: 似乎每周都有一个新的城镇在庆祝。

sentences.en: I started telling people, tape it.
sentences.zh: 我开始告诉人们，把它录下来。

sentences.en: A lot of these celebration videos included fireworks, which Jorge said in real life became
sentences.zh: 很多这样的庆祝视频里都有烟花，豪尔赫说在现实生活中，烟花成了

sentences.en: sort of a beacon, you'd see them from far away, and you'd know.
sentences.zh: 一种信号，你从很远的地方就能看到，然后你就知道了。

sentences.en: That guy just got power right now, and this is their celebration.
sentences.zh: 那家伙刚通上电，这就是他们的庆祝方式。

sentences.en: In the comments to these celebration videos, Jorge assured people that soon it would be their turn.
sentences.zh: 在这些庆祝视频的评论区里，豪尔赫向人们保证，很快就会轮到他们了。

sentences.en: Just remember that even if you don't have power right now, you will have it, and this is going to be you.
sentences.zh: 只要记住，即使你现在还没电，你也会有的，到时候这就是你们的样子。

sentences.en: Power has now been restored to all of Puerto Rico.
sentences.zh: 波多黎各现已全面恢复供电。

sentences.en: It's been nearly 11 months since Hurricane Maria roared ashore and took out the power.
sentences.zh: 距离玛丽亚飓风咆哮着登陆并摧毁电力系统已经过去近 11 个月了。

sentences.en: Finally, in August of 2018, Prepa announced that the entire island had been reconnected to the grid.
sentences.zh: 最终，在 2018 年 8 月，波多黎各电力局（PREPA）宣布全岛已重新接入电网。

sentences.en: It was six weeks before the year anniversary of Maria, and just in time for the next hurricane season.
sentences.zh: 这距离玛丽亚飓风周年纪念日还有六周，正好赶在下一个飓风季节到来之前。

sentences.en: Prepa, meanwhile, is arguably in a worse place than it was before Maria.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，PREPA 的处境可以说比玛丽亚飓风之前还要糟糕。

sentences.en: There's been a lack of steady leadership over the last year, with five different directors cycling through the position at the helm.
sentences.zh: 过去一年里，该机构缺乏稳定的领导层，掌舵人位置换了五位不同的主管。

sentences.en: When a guy lasted, you know, like a day, there was a sense of a rudderless ship, to be honeSt.
sentences.zh: 老实说，当一个人只干了，你知道，比如一天就离职时，会给人一种群龙无首的感觉。

sentences.en: A sense of an absolutely rudderless ship.
sentences.zh: 一种彻底群龙无首的感觉。

sentences.en: For years, a weird FEMA rule had been in place that recipients of disaster money couldn't replace anything with a different, i.e. more expensive thing.
sentences.zh: 多年来，联邦紧急事务管理局（FEMA）一直有一条奇怪的规定，即灾难资金的接受者不能用不同的，也就是更昂贵的东西来替换原有设施。

sentences.en: For example, wooden posts couldn't be replaced with stronger metal posts.
sentences.zh: 例如，木质电线杆不能换成更坚固的金属电线杆。

sentences.en: So, Puerto Ricans didn't actually get the opportunity to improve their infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 所以，波多黎各人实际上并没有机会改善他们的基础设施。

sentences.en: It's the same grid they had before, with a population that's significantly more vulnerable.
sentences.zh: 这还是他们以前用的那套电网，而现在的人口却更加脆弱。

sentences.en: And Daniel says this part can't be overstated.
sentences.zh: 丹尼尔说这一点怎么强调都不为过。

sentences.en: Puerto Ricans were traumatized by Maria.
sentences.zh: 波多黎各人受到了玛丽亚飓风的创伤。

sentences.en: It's not just that they went through this storm and then went through the aftermath of the storm.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是因为他们经历了这场风暴，又经历了风暴过后的余波。

sentences.en: It's, I think, for a lot of people, it's what the aftermath of the storm told them, which is essentially, we don't care about you.
sentences.zh: 我认为，对很多人来说，这是风暴余波告诉他们的事实，本质上就是：我们不在乎你们。

sentences.en: You're not, you're forgotten, you don't matter.
sentences.zh: 你们不重要，你们被遗忘了，你们无足轻重。

sentences.en: The depth of this wound is just, just very, very deep.
sentences.zh: 这种伤口的深度，真的，真的非常深。

sentences.en: Now, PREPA is in the process of privatizing,
sentences.zh: 现在，PREPA 正在进行私有化，

sentences.en: basically selling itself off piece by piece in hopes that a private company or various private companies will be able to deliver a better service than the government has.
sentences.zh: 基本上是在一点一点地出售自己，希望一家私营公司或多家私营公司能够提供比政府更好的服务。

sentences.en: But a lot of people are skeptical.
sentences.zh: 但很多人对此持怀疑态度。

sentences.en: Jorge Bracero is still working at PREPA, still doing the hot, exhausting job of maintaining a 15-story boiler.
sentences.zh: 豪尔赫·布拉塞罗仍在 PREPA 工作，依然从事着维护 15 层高锅炉的艰苦工作。

sentences.en: He'd like to stop doing such hard, physical labor.
sentences.zh: 他想停止这种高强度的体力劳动。

sentences.en: He'd like someone to put him in charge of social media or put his other talents to use.
sentences.zh: 他希望有人能让他负责社交媒体，或者让他发挥其他才能。

sentences.en: I'm up for it.
sentences.zh: 我愿意做这个。

sentences.en: I would love that.
sentences.zh: 我会很乐意的。

sentences.en: But so far, they haven't.
sentences.zh: 但到目前为止，他们还没有这样做。

sentences.en: Hurricane season was in full swing when I talked to Jorge.
sentences.zh: 我和豪尔赫交谈时，飓风季节正处于高峰期。

sentences.en: So, of course, I asked him how he was feeling about that.
sentences.zh: 所以，我当然问了他对此有何感想。

sentences.en: When people ask me, it's like, are we ready for our next hurricane?
sentences.zh: 当人们问我，我们为下一次飓风做好准备了吗？

sentences.en: And I'm like, no, we need a break.
sentences.zh: 我会说，不，我们需要休息一下。

sentences.en: Just give us, I don't know, maybe two years.
sentences.zh: 给我们，我不知道，也许两年时间吧。

sentences.en: Just give us that time, that window in which our people can keep working, keep working, keep working, so that that system can hold a little longer.
sentences.zh: 给我们那段时间，那个窗口期，让我们的员工可以继续工作、继续工作、继续工作，这样系统就能多支撑一会儿。

sentences.en: Climate change and everything that comes with it is a reality.
sentences.zh: 气候变化及其带来的一切都是现实。

sentences.en: You know, hurricane seasons are going to get longer.
sentences.zh: 你知道，飓风季节会变得越来越长。

sentences.en: We're going to see more, you know, and that's pretty scary.
sentences.zh: 我们会看到更多（飓风），你知道，这真的很可怕。

sentences.en: Jorge told me he thinks Puerto Ricans could survive another hurricane if they had to, another year in the dark even.
sentences.zh: 豪尔赫告诉我，他认为如果必须的话，波多黎各人可以再挺过一场飓风，甚至再在黑暗中生活一年。

sentences.en: He wouldn't worry as much about the island devolving into anarchy as he once did.
sentences.zh: 他不像以前那样担心岛上会陷入无政府状态了。

sentences.en: He saw the best of people after Maria, and he thinks they could do it again.
sentences.zh: 他在玛丽亚飓风后看到了人性中最美好的一面，他认为他们能再次做到。

sentences.en: Just please, please.
sentences.zh: 只是拜托，拜托。

sentences.en: Not this year.
sentences.zh: 别是今年。

sentences.en: Jorge Bracero was not the only person in Puerto Rico to take matters into their own hands after Maria.
sentences.zh: 豪尔赫·布拉塞罗并不是玛丽亚飓风后波多黎各唯一一个采取自主行动的人。

sentences.en: All over the island, people were stepping into new roles and figuring out DIY solutions.
sentences.zh: 在全岛各地，人们都在承担新的角色，并想出各种 DIY 的解决方案。

sentences.en: But one town that Daniel Alarcón visited took this really, really far.
sentences.zh: 但丹尼尔·阿拉尔孔访问的一个城镇把这一点做得非常、非常彻底。

sentences.en: The people actually said, to hell with waiting on Prepa.
sentences.zh: 人们实际上说，去他的，别等 PREPA 了。

sentences.en: We're doing this work ourselves.
sentences.zh: 我们自己来做这项工作。

sentences.en: Daniel will tell us that story after this.
sentences.zh: 丹尼尔稍后会为我们讲述那个故事。

sentences.en: So it seems like all over Puerto Rico, people were kind of taking matters into their own hands.
sentences.zh: 看来在整个波多黎各，人们都在某种程度上采取了自主行动。

sentences.en: Tell me about this town you went to that basically took it upon themselves to get the lights turned back on.
sentences.zh: 跟我说说你去的那个城镇，他们基本上是自己动手恢复了供电。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是这样。

sentences.en: In this one town called San Sebastián del Pepino, they took a pretty radical step,
sentences.zh: 在这个叫圣塞瓦斯蒂安德尔佩皮诺的小镇，他们采取了一个相当激进的步骤，
zh_words: 圣塞瓦斯蒂安德尔佩皮诺

sentences.en: which is that they took volunteers and sort of turned them into linemen and created their own kind of unofficial brigade to connect and reconnect San Sebastián to the grid.
sentences.zh: 那就是他们招募志愿者，把他们变成了电力工人，并建立了自己的非官方抢修队，将圣塞瓦斯蒂安重新接入电网。

sentences.en: That's amazing.
sentences.zh: 太神奇了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: The mayor, he's a charming guy with a rhetorical flourish and knows how to give a speech and make a statement.
sentences.zh: 镇长是个很有魅力的人，说话很有修辞技巧，懂得如何发表演讲和发表声明。

sentences.en: And basically he was saying, I had no choice.
sentences.zh: 他基本上是在说，我别无选择。

sentences.en: It was more dangerous to leave my vulnerable population without electrical power because a lot of people are older and sick and would have died without power.
sentences.zh: 让我的弱势群体在没有电力的情况下生活更危险，因为很多人年纪大了，身体不好，没有电就会死。

sentences.en: They basically got tired of waiting.
sentences.zh: 他们基本上是等得不耐烦了。

sentences.en: They started doing the work on their own, which is super dangerous.
sentences.zh: 他们开始自己动手干活，这非常危险。

sentences.en: Like how did they even know how to do it?
sentences.zh: 他们是怎么知道该怎么做的？

sentences.en: Like did they watch YouTube tutorials or like...
sentences.zh: 他们是看了 YouTube 教程还是……

sentences.en: Well, so here's the thing.
sentences.zh: 嗯，事情是这样的。

sentences.en: As it happened before the storm, they had bought a couple of decommissioned PREPA trucks with the buckets that rise.
sentences.zh: 风暴发生前，他们买了几辆退役的 PREPA 工程车，就是那种带升降斗的。

sentences.en: They bought them so they could cut brush.
sentences.zh: 他们买这些车是为了修剪灌木。

sentences.en: The hurricane comes and they're like, well, we've got these trucks.
sentences.zh: 飓风来了，他们想，好吧，我们有这些车。

sentences.en: And they had one guy who had worked as a lineman and another guy who knew a little bit about it.
sentences.zh: 他们有一个人曾做过电力工人，还有一个人对此略知一二。

sentences.en: And they'd say, okay, everybody, we need help with clearing this brush so we can get to that line, you know, to that electrical pole over there.
sentences.zh: 他们会说，好了，大家，我们需要帮忙清理这些灌木，这样我们才能到达那条线路，你知道，就是那边那根电线杆。

sentences.en: And then everyone would take out their machetes and help clear the line.
sentences.zh: 然后大家就会拿出砍刀，帮忙清理线路。

sentences.en: And then they would go and do the work.
sentences.zh: 然后他们就会去干活。

sentences.en: They had their whole town connected six to eight weeks before the other towns, the other areas around there.
sentences.zh: 他们在其他城镇和周边地区通电前六到八周就让全镇通了电。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And this was just okay?
sentences.zh: 这真的没问题吗？

sentences.en: Like they didn't get in trouble?
sentences.zh: 他们没惹上麻烦吗？

sentences.en: Like did PREPA know what they were doing?
sentences.zh: PREPA 知道他们在做什么吗？

sentences.en: PREPA had a kind of, you know, they couldn't officially sanction this work.
sentences.zh: PREPA 有一种，你知道，他们无法正式批准这项工作。

sentences.en: They were certainly coordinating.
sentences.zh: 他们当然是在协调。

sentences.en: You know, they had to coordinate because they couldn't be energizing a line while, you know,
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们必须协调，因为他们不能在佩皮诺电力局的人正在把线路连接到电线杆上时，给线路通电，你懂吗？

sentences.en: Pepino Power Authority guys were connecting it to some poles, you know?
sentences.zh: 所以佩皮诺电力局听起来很正式。

sentences.en: So Pepino Power Authority sounds so official.
sentences.zh: 这是一个官方机构，还是一个编造的名字？

sentences.en: Was this an official body or is this just a made up name?
sentences.zh: 佩皮诺电力局完全是一个非正式的编造名称。

sentences.en: So the Pepino Power Authority is completely an informal made up thing.
sentences.zh: 佩皮诺在西班牙语里是黄瓜的意思。

sentences.en: Pepino means cucumber in Spanish.
sentences.zh: 你知道我的意思吗？

sentences.en: You know what I mean?
sentences.zh: 我想当你发现它是黄瓜的时候，听起来就不那么正式了。

sentences.en: I guess it sounds less official when you know it's cucumber.
sentences.zh: 嗯，没错。

sentences.en: Well, right.
sentences.zh: 我认为这就是，我是说，这就是你意识到镇长哈维尔·希门尼斯有多精明的地方，你懂吗？

sentences.en: And I think that's one of the, I mean, that's where you sort of realize like exactly how savvy Javier Jimenez, the mayor, is, you know?
sentences.zh: 这显然是在玩 PREPA 的梗，你懂吗？

sentences.en: It's obviously a play on PREPA, you know?
sentences.zh: 波多黎各电力局（PREPA），佩皮诺电力局，你知道，就像是，

sentences.en: Puerto Rican Electrical Power Authority, Pepino Power Authority, you know, it's like,
sentences.zh: 这也是懂得如何讲故事的一部分。

sentences.en: and it's part of knowing how to tell a story.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他因为这个获得了很大的关注，而且奏效了。

sentences.en: You know, he got a lot of play for this and it worked.
sentences.zh: 结果之一是，在这之后有人提议立法，放宽对镇长和地方当局进行此类活动的限制。

sentences.en: One of the results is there was a law proposed after all of this that was going to loosen the restrictions for mayors and local authorities to do the kind of thing that he did.
sentences.zh: 最后提一句，这实际上并没有成为法律。

sentences.en: Just a final note, it actually wasn't a law that got passed.
sentences.zh: 这更多是 PREPA 和各市长之间的一项协议，基本上是说，

sentences.en: It was more of an agreement between PREPA and mayors of cities that basically says,
sentences.zh: 是的，如果市长们愿意，他们可以做连接电网的工作。

sentences.en: yeah, mayors can do the work of connecting people to the grid if they want.
sentences.zh: 如果有人受伤，PREPA 不承担责任。

sentences.en: And PREPA is not responsible if anyone gets hurt.
